title: Pimlico geometry diagnostics and historical site review
interpretation: Modern roof overlap measures display coverage, not historical accuracy or the completeness of bomb sites. Replacement buildings are a different observation unit from historical properties.

blockers: Add at least 12 distributed fitting landmarks.
Add at least 8 independent check landmarks.
Identify the source image and its SHA-256 checksum.
Record the median frontage width measured in the reviewed sample.

draftTracePlacement.note: Legacy areas retain the original placement. Four local groups are replaced by screenshot-based historical terrace segments using a separate exploratory local transform.

sourceImage.description: User-supplied archive viewer screenshot; pixels measured in this exact 1067 by 672 image

localStudy.traceNote: Simplified visible terrace segments traced manually from the supplied screenshot, including separate categories on opposite street frontages. Rear projections, individual property divisions and uncertain tiny markings are not resolved. These are draft historical areas, not reviewed individual houses.

registration.note: Local affine placement from three road-junction centres picked manually in the screenshot to OSM node coordinates. Three other road-junction picks were withheld. This is an exploratory alignment, not independent survey or a passed registration gate.
